title: 复合句与从句
subtitle: 名词从句、定语从句、状语从句三大体系

intro.title: 什么是从句？
intro.body:
**从句（Subordinate Clause）** 有完整的主谓结构，但不能独立成句，必须依附主句。这与短语（phrase，无主谓结构）不同：

- 短语：*the tall man*（无主谓）
- 从句：*the man **who is tall***（有主谓 who is）

**三大类型：**

| 从句类型 | 功能 | 引导词举例 |
|---------|------|----------|
| **名词性从句** | 充当名词成分（主、宾、表、同位） | that, what, whether, who, how |
| **定语从句** | 修饰名词/代词 | who, whom, whose, which, that |
| **状语从句** | 修饰动词/形容词/全句 | because, although, if, when |

intro.title: 名词性从句（一）：主语、宾语、表语从句
intro.body:
**主语从句** 充当句子主语，谓语用单数；常用形式主语 it 避免「头重脚轻」：
- *That he survived is a miracle.* → ***It** is a miracle that he survived.*
- *What you said surprised everyone.*
- *Whether she will attend is still uncertain.*

**宾语从句** 是最常见的名词从句，充当动词或形容词的宾语：
- *I believe **(that)** he is honest.*（that 在宾语从句中可省略）
- *He asked **whether/if** she would come.*
- *I'm sure **(that)** he'll pass.*

**表语从句** 跟在系动词后说明主语内容：
- *The truth is **that** nobody knows.*
- *The problem is **whether** we can afford it.*

**易错点：** reason 后用 that，不用 because！
- ❌ *The reason is **because** he was late.*
- ✓ *The reason is **that** he was late.*
intro.tip: if 只能引导宾语从句（非正式）；whether 可引导所有名词性从句，更正式。

intro.title: 名词性从句（二）：同位语从句 vs that/what/whether 辨析
intro.body:
**同位语从句** 紧跟抽象名词之后，解释该名词的具体内容（与之是「等同」关系）：
- *The fact **that he resigned** shocked everyone.*
- *The news **that the company went bankrupt** spread quickly.*
- *There is a possibility **that she may be lying**.*

常见先行名词：fact, idea, news, belief, hope, suggestion, possibility, evidence...

**that / what / whether 三者区别：**

| 引导词 | 从句是否完整 | 词本身的成分 | 典型用法 |
|--------|------------|-------------|----------|
| **that** | 完整 | 无（纯连词） | *I know that he left.* |
| **what** | 不完整（有空位）| 主语或宾语 | *I know what he said.*（what = 宾语空位）|
| **whether** | 完整 | 无（表「是否」）| *I don't know whether he's coming.* |

**判断技巧：** 如果从句去掉引导词后仍是完整句 → 用 that；如果有成分缺失 → 用 what。
intro.tip: 介词后面不能接 that 从句：I'm interested in **what** you said.（不能用 that）

intro.title: 定语从句（一）：关系代词 who/whom/whose/which/that
intro.body:
定语从句紧跟先行词之后，相当于一个形容词。**关系代词选择：**

| 关系代词 | 先行词 | 在从句中的成分 | 例句 |
|---------|-------|--------------|------|
| **who** | 人 | 主语 | *The man **who called** you is my uncle.* |
| **whom** | 人 | 宾语（正式）| *The man **whom you met** is famous.* |
| **whose** | 人/物 | 定语（所有格）| *The girl **whose bag was stolen** cried.* |
| **which** | 物/整句 | 主语或宾语 | *The book **which I read** was fascinating.* |
| **that** | 人或物 | 主语或宾语 | *Everything **that she said** was false.* |

**who vs whom 检验法：** 把从句单独提出，用 he/him 替换——用 he 则用 who，用 him 则用 whom：
- *The man who called you* → He called you（he → who）✓
- *The man whom you met* → You met him（him → whom）✓

**that 必须用于：** 先行词被 only/first/last/every/all/no 修饰时；先行词既有人又有物时。
**that 不能用于：** 非限制性定语从句（有逗号）；介词之后。
intro.tip: 口语中 whom 常被 who 替代，但介词后必须用 whom：The man **to whom** I spoke.

intro.title: 定语从句（二）：限制性 vs 非限制性——一个逗号的差异
intro.body:
**限制性定语从句（无逗号）**：提供必要信息，限定先行词范围；去掉从句后句意不完整或改变：
- *Students **who study hard** will pass.*（只有努力的学生才会通过）

**非限制性定语从句（有逗号）**：提供附加信息，先行词已确定；去掉从句句意完整：
- *My sister, **who lives in New York**, is visiting us.*（只有一个妹妹，从句只是补充信息）

**意义对比：**
- *I have two brothers **who are doctors**.*（暗示我可能还有其他兄弟不是医生）
- *I have two brothers, **who are doctors**.*（我只有两个兄弟，两人都是医生）

**关系副词：**
- *where* = 地点名词 → *The city **where** I was born*（= in which）
- *when* = 时间名词 → *The day **when** we first met*（= on which）
- *why* = reason → *The reason **why** he left*（= for which）

**省略规则：** 关系代词在从句中作**宾语**时可省略（限制性从句）：
- *The book (that/which) I read was fascinating.*（that/which 可省略）
- *The book **that** changed my life was great.*（that 作主语，不可省略）

reveal.q:
以下两句含义一样吗？
A: The students who failed the exam were disappointed.
B: The students, who failed the exam, were disappointed.
reveal.a: 含义不同！A（限制性，无逗号）表示「不及格的那部分学生」很失望，暗示有些学生及格了。B（非限制性，有逗号）表示「全体学生」都很失望，因为都不及格。

intro.title: 状语从句（一）：时间、原因、让步
intro.body:
**时间状语从句** 重要规则：**时间状语从句不用将来时！**
- ❌ *I'll call you when I **will arrive**.*
- ✓ *I'll call you when I **arrive**.*

常见引导词区别：
- **when**：时间节点 → *When the bell rings, class ends.*
- **while**：持续动作（常用进行时）→ *While I was cooking, he was reading.*
- **as**：两动作同步 → *As time passed, she grew wiser.*
- **not...until**：「直到……才」→ *She didn't stop **until** midnight.*
- **as soon as**：「一……就」→ *As soon as she arrived, the meeting started.*

**原因状语从句：**
- **because**：直接原因（最强，回答 why）→ *She was late because she missed the bus.*
- **since/as**：已知背景原因（较弱）→ *Since you're here, let's begin.*
- **now that**：强调情况已改变 → *Now that you've grown up, take responsibility.*

**让步状语从句：**
- **although/though**：尽管 → *Although it was cold, she went out.*
- **even though**（实际让步）vs **even if**（假设让步）
- **易错**：although 与 but 不能共用！
  - ❌ *Although she was tired, **but** she kept working.*
  - ✓ *Although she was tired, she kept working.*

intro.title: 状语从句（二）：目的、结果与分词省略
intro.body:
**目的状语从句** — so that/in order that + can/could/will/would：
- *She spoke slowly **so that** everyone could understand.*
- *He set an alarm **so that** he wouldn't oversleep.*

**结果状语从句** — so...that / such...that：
- *He spoke **so** quietly **that** no one could hear him.*（so + 形容词/副词 + that）
- *It was **such** a boring film **that** I fell asleep.*（such + 名词短语 + that）

**目的 vs 结果辨析：**
- *She studied hard **so that** she could pass.*（目的：为了能通过）
- *She studied **so** hard **that** she passed.*（结果：学得太努力，以至于通过了）

**状语从句的省略（分词结构）** — 主句与从句主语一致时，可简化为分词：
- *While **she was walking** home, she met a friend.* → ***Walking** home, she met a friend.*
- *After **she had finished** homework, she went to bed.* → ***After finishing** homework, she went to bed.*
- ***Because she was exhausted**, she slept early.* → ***Exhausted**, she slept early.*

**注意：** 主语不一致时不能省略，否则产生悬垂分词（dangling participle）：
- ❌ ***Walking down the street**, the trees were beautiful.*（trees 不能 walk）
- ✓ ***Walking down the street**, I noticed the beautiful trees.*
intro.tip: 分词省略的关键：谁在做动作？要确保分词的逻辑主语与主句主语一致。

intro.title: 长难句分析：括号法与找主干法
intro.body:
真实英语文章中从句常多层嵌套，需要系统方法拆解。

**括号法** — 将各层从句用括号标注，逐层剥离：

原句：*The evidence [that scientists have gathered] suggests [that the process [by which the climate changes] is far more complex than [the models [that were developed in the 1990s] predicted]].*

主干还原：*The evidence suggests [that the process is more complex than the models predicted].* 
（科学家的证据表明，气候变化的过程比模型预测的更复杂）

**找主干法** — 快速定位步骤：
1. 找最外层的主动词（非从句内的动词）
2. 找该动词的主语（可能被从句隔开）
3. 找宾语/表语
4. 将所有从句视为整体成分忽略

**常见长难句模式：**
- 形式主语：*It is widely believed that [educated people make better decisions].*
- 状语从句 + 主句 + 定语从句：*Although the results [that the team obtained] were promising, further research is needed.*
steps: 第一步：找到主句的主动词（不在任何从句内的动词）
第二步：找主动词的主语（注意可能被定语从句或插入语隔开）
第四步：将各层从句用括号标出，还原主干含义

questions.prompt:
下列句子中，划线部分属于哪种从句？
"The fact **that he had lied** shocked his colleagues."
options: 定语从句，修饰 fact
同位语从句，解释 fact 的具体内容
宾语从句，充当 shocked 的宾语
主语从句，充当句子主语
questions.explain: "that he had lied" 是同位语从句，与先行名词 fact 是「等同」关系，解释 fact 的具体内容（什么事实？他撒谎了这件事实）。定语从句是修饰/限定先行词范围，而同位语从句是对先行词内容的解释和说明，这是两者的核心区别。

questions.prompt: 以下哪个句子使用了**非限制性定语从句**？
options: Students who study hard will pass the exam.
The book that I borrowed from you is fascinating.
My father, who works in a bank, is very busy.
Is this the house that Jack built?
questions.explain: 非限制性定语从句有逗号，提供附加信息，先行词已确定。选项 C "My father, who works in a bank, is very busy." 有逗号，且 my father 已经是确定唯一的人，从句只是补充说他在银行工作。其他选项都是限制性定语从句（无逗号，限定范围）。

questions.prompt: 判断："Although she was exhausted, but she kept working." 这个句子语法正确。
questions.explain: 错误。although 和 but 不能同时使用——although 已经表达了让步关系，再加 but 是重复。正确写法只能二选一："Although she was exhausted, she kept working." 或 "She was exhausted, but she kept working."

questions.prompt:
填入最合适的引导词：
"I'm interested in ______ you said at the meeting."
options: that
what
which
whether
questions.explain: 介词 in 后面不能接 that 从句（that 引导的名词从句不能做介词宾语）。应用 what，它在从句中充当 said 的宾语（you said ___ = 你说了什么），从句有成分缺失，用 what。"what you said" = "the thing(s) that you said"。

questions.prompt: 判断："I will call you as soon as I will arrive at the airport." 这个句子语法正确。
questions.explain: 错误。时间状语从句（as soon as 引导）不用将来时，应用一般现在时替代将来时。正确写法："I will call you as soon as I **arrive** at the airport."

questions.prompt: 将引导词与对应的语义/用法匹配：
right: 原因从句（既然，强调情况已变）
questions.explain: although = 让步（尽管）；so that = 目的（为了/以便）；so...that = 结果（如此……以至于）；now that = 原因（既然，强调情况已经改变）。so that 和 so...that 是最容易混淆的一对。

questions.prompt: 将 "While she was reading the report, she noticed several errors." 改为分词省略结构，正确的是？
options: While reading the report, several errors were noticed.
Reading the report, she noticed several errors.
Being read the report, she noticed several errors.
She reading the report, noticed several errors.
questions.explain: 状语从句省略为分词结构时，从句主语（she）与主句主语（she）一致，可以省略从句主语并将动词改为现在分词。"While she was reading" → "Reading"（while 也可省略）。选项 A 的主语变成了 errors（不能 read），产生悬垂分词错误。

questions.prompt:
用 who 或 whom 填空（选择语法正确的关系代词）：
"She is the professor ______ I told you about."
questions.explain: 正式语法中应用 whom，因为关系代词在从句中充当介词 about 的宾语（I told you about **her**，用 her → 用 whom）。但口语中 who 也被广泛接受。正式书面语写作推荐 whom。

questions.prompt: 以下哪句中，that 的省略是**不合适的**（即必须保留 that）？
options: I think (that) you're right.
She said (that) she was busy.
The book that changed my life was fascinating.
I believe (that) he is honest.
questions.explain: 关系代词 that 在定语从句中充当**主语**时不能省略。选项 C 中 that 是定语从句 "that changed my life" 的主语，必须保留。选项 A、B、D 中 that 引导宾语从句（that 在其中不充当主语或宾语，只是连词），可以省略。
